title: Baidu announces proposed spin-off and Hong Kong Main Board listing of AI chip unit Kunlunxin
summary: Baidu said its AI chip arm Kunlunxin confidentially filed a Hong Kong listing application on 1 Jan; later reports cite a target valuation up to $50bn and a parallel STAR Market guidance process begun 7 May.

title: EQT to Launch USD 371 million Tender Offer for MAMEZO
summary: EQT's BPEA Mid-Market Growth fund launched a JPY 3,551-a-share (about JPY 57bn, $371m) tender offer to take Tokyo IT services and AI modernisation firm MAMEZO private, with Itochu as strategic partner.
